headline: Prime Minister explains how Ukraine plans to close the $27 billion deficit
summary: The government will seek about $7 billion domestically, with the rest to be raised from international partners, according to Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko's explanation of the plan.
why: Ukraine's budget gap depends on external financing from donors and lenders, which determines its macroeconomic stability and sovereign creditworthiness.
